events.text:
T-237 is in review: the public webinar sign-up is deployed, but the push, the live test registration and the masterclass link are still open.

- **Built:** `https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev/webinar/register` has a form page and a POST route. It makes one add-registrant call and returns the person's own join link. Repeats and placeholder emails get no Zoom call. The admin gets a signups list and a mark-as-test action.
- **Verified:** the new probe passes 14 of 14 against vendor-sim. I did not open the page in a headless browser. Migration 0025 is applied remotely and the Worker is deployed (b380890f).
- **Probe side effect:** the existing `probe-zoom-pro.mjs` showed 4 engagement failures on my local centre. I didn't investigate; I suspect leftover simulator state.
- **Push failed:** the push to main was rejected because origin is ahead. I didn't rebase over other lanes' uncommitted work.
- **Live test not run:** production has no webinar scheduled, so the page says "not scheduled yet". Once someone schedules one in the admin, the [email] test can run, and Bhaskar can then place the link.
- **Tantra import:** recorded as pending until T-234's webinar campaign setting exists.

I also killed the shared vendor-sim on :8792 by mistake and restarted it.
